creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The core owns composition and does not have one yet. Two things in the
code already say so in their own comments: the mirror is a static
because there is one window and one daemon, and its subscription hangs
off the attached pane rather than off the daemon it describes.

What this needs to become is which daemons are attached, and which
(daemon, workspace, tab) shows in which window region - plus view-local
focus, meaning which pane Muster's keyboard feeds, which is never read
back from the daemon's own cursor.

Keep it plain records (a_27QcqNxRB). This is the only durable state
Muster has and it is a few hundred bytes; written as records it can be
saved later for nothing, and written as a graph of view objects it
cannot be saved at all.

Also here: the control socket is one per process today and has to
become one per pane.
title: 🗂️ Composition: which daemon, which tab, which region
